topic_title: How Alcohol and Other Drugs Affect Driving Ability
prompt: At what constant rate does the human liver metabolize and eliminate alcohol from the bloodstream?

options.text: Approximately three standard drinks per hour if the person drinks hot black coffee
Approximately one standard drink per hour (lowering BAC by roughly 0.015% per hour)
Approximately two standard drinks per hour when exercising vigorously outdoors
The liver eliminates all consumed alcohol immediately within twenty-five minutes
